summary: Independently compared durable SINGLE_PASS and BLOCK_REVIEW macro-batch canaries using their exact RETURNs and candidate artifacts. Both satisfy authority/no-subtask-row/no-promotion boundaries. BLOCK_REVIEW durably records four checkpoint-intercepted defects plus two final-audit defects and has a dedicated negative-fixture harness; SINGLE_PASS records five defects and a smaller one-path candidate mutation. Complete external I/O and matched timing are not homologous, and defect taxonomies/workloads differ, so causal superiority is INCONCLUSIVE and no winner is declared.
tests: VERIFIED both returns are durable DONE/SUCCESS-class candidate results without pipeline/current promotion.
VERIFIED SINGLE_PASS candidate contains 20 local decisions and zero durable subtask rows.
VERIFIED BLOCK_REVIEW candidate contains 12 subtasks, four local checkpoints and zero durable subtask rows.
VERIFIED BLOCK_REVIEW records four checkpoint defects plus two final-audit defects.
VERIFIED SINGLE_PASS records five candidate defects without block checkpoint attribution.
VERIFIED BLOCK_REVIEW includes a structural Node harness with four negative fixtures.
PARTIAL causal checkpoint benefit: interception is observed, counterfactual escape rate is not.
INCOMPARABLE complete external I/O: SINGLE_PASS connector-operation count is UNKNOWN and BLOCK_REVIEW lacks homologous full ledger.
INCOMPARABLE timing: neither arm supplies matched independent external timing for the local production block.
PASS no winner, no WORKER_PIPELINE/CURRENT promotion.
unresolved: No causal quality winner can be inferred from differently sized, differently instrumented canaries.
Full homologous connector-operation and matched external timing evidence is absent.
truth_boundary: This is a verified dimensional comparison, not a causal winner selection or baseline promotion.
